candidate.title: AI2's 16x Smaller Model Outperforms GPT-3 by 10% in Question Answering
candidate.description:
Macaw
https://macaw.apps.allenai.org/about

Macaw is a high-performance question-answering (QA) model capable of outperforming other 
popular current language models, all while being an order of magnitude smaller. This demo allows you to explore Macaw's answers and compare them to those of the popular GPT-3 language model on a benchmark set of questions.
